analysis_result.analysis: The model misaligned the temporal sequence of rope drawings. While it correctly identified colors appearing in frames, it failed to map them to the true chronological order of drawing events. Ground truth explicitly lists the drawing order as: red, purple, yellow, blue, orange, green, white — making green the 6th. The model’s frame-by-frame assignment (yellow=1st, blue=2nd, red=3rd, orange=4th, green=5th, purple=6th) contradicts this, indicating a failure in tracking the actual temporal progression of the scene.
